title: Lighter — open a minimal position through the real order form
description: Navigates to the market, presses Long/Short, accepts the venue-minimum seeded amount, places the market order through the UI, and verifies the position against the venue. Re-entrant: when a position already exists the UI-open leg is skipped and the unit just verifies it (ensure semantics via graph branching).

market.intent: Open the market page the trade starts from.

settle-market.intent: Let live prices render so the trade buttons are active.

press-direction.intent: Start the trade the way a user does.

settle-form.intent: Let the order form mount and seed the venue-minimum amount.

form-ready.intent: The order form is on screen with its place button (presence check — viewport measurement is unreliable under chart load).

shot-form.intent: Record the seeded order form before placing.

place.intent: Place the market order from the real button.

settle-place.intent: Give the venue time to fill and the app time to sync.

shot-open.intent: Record what the user sees after the fill.

check.intent: Read whether a position already exists so the unit can converge instead of failing on a re-run.

branch.intent: Open through the UI only when no position exists; an existing position already satisfies this unit.
